cards.titleEn: Can Dual-Polarity Memory Improve Agent Repair Without Parameter Updates?
cards.originalTitle: Causal Episodic Memory for Feedback-Driven Agent Repair
cards.summaryEn: Facts: The authors study whether finalized repair outcomes can improve subsequent Text-to-SQL episodes without parameter updates, and introduce MERIT, a training-free agent that maintains an online dual-polarity memory of oracle-verified corrections and observed unsuccessful directions; only memories from earlier finalized episodes are eligible for retrieval; a deterministic classifier assigns a coarse failure type that conditions a hybrid lexical-dense retriever before the frozen model generates each revision. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, identical initial predictions, and repair budgets, MERIT improves execution accuracy over stateless iterative repair from 66.34% to 69.79% on Spider and from 47.35% to 48.44% on BIRD; paired analyses provide clear evidence for the Spider gain but weaker evidence on BIRD; MERIT is not reliably separated from untyped dynamic retrieval on either benchmark, while Reflexion-style memory reaches 51.24% on BIRD at substantially higher inference cost; ablations show negative memory contributes modestly, the value of type conditioning and lexical-dense ranking is dataset dependent, and schema-local experience provides the most consistent benefit. Authors' view: These results clarify when causal cross-query memory improves repair and when broader memory representations remain preferable.
keyPointsEn: MERIT is a training-free Text-to-SQL repair agent that does not update frozen model parameters and influences subsequent generation only through online memory.
The memory is dual-polarity: it stores oracle-verified corrections and observed unsuccessful directions, and only memories from earlier finalized episodes are retrieved.
A deterministic classifier first assigns a coarse failure type, which then conditions a hybrid lexical-dense retriever to provide context for each revision.
With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, identical initial predictions, and repair budgets, execution accuracy rises from 66.34% to 69.79% on Spider and from 47.35% to 48.44% on BIRD.
Paired analyses provide clear evidence for the Spider gain but weaker evidence on BIRD; MERIT is not reliably separated from untyped dynamic retrieval on either benchmark.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work turns failure repair from one-shot trial and error into accumulable cross-query experience, and provides a comparison of memory designs under a fixed model and repair budget without fine-tuning. Its experiments also show that gains depend heavily on the benchmark and memory organization: on Spider, causal dual-polarity memory yields a clear gain over stateless repair, but on BIRD the evidence is weaker, a simple untyped dynamic retrieval is hard to significantly outperform, and Reflexion-style memory is numerically higher on BIRD at greater cost. This helps researchers judge when more structured causal memory is appropriate and when broader memory representations are preferable, rather than treating the method as universally optimal.
cards.summary: 事实：作者研究已完成的修复结果能否在不更新参数的情况下改善后续 Text-to-SQL 轮次，并提出 MERIT：一个免训练的智能体，维护 oracle 验证修正与观察到的失败方向的在线双极性记忆；只在较早且已完成轮次的记忆可被检索；确定性分类器给出粗粒度失败类型，用于条件化混合词法—稠密检索器，再由冻结模型生成每次修正。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、相同初始预测和修复预算下，MERIT 相对无状态迭代修复把 Spider 执行准确率从 66.34% 提升到 69.79%，BIRD 从 47.35% 提升到 48.44%；配对分析对 Spider 增益给出清晰证据，对 BIRD 证据较弱；MERIT 在两个基准上均未能可靠地区别于无类型的动态检索，而 Reflexion 式记忆在 BIRD 达到 51.24%，推理成本显著更高；消融显示负向记忆贡献有限，类型条件化与词法—稠密排序的价值依赖数据集，schema 局部经验给出最一致的收益。作者观点：这些结果厘清了因果跨查询记忆何时改善修复、何时更宽泛的记忆表示更可取。
cards.title: 无需更新参数的双极性记忆能否提升智能体修复
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作把“修复失败”从一次性试错转为可积累的跨查询经验，并给出在固定模型与修复预算下、无需微调即可比较的记忆设计。其实验同时显示，收益高度依赖基准与记忆组织方式：Spider 上因果双极性记忆相对无状态修复有清晰增益，但 BIRD 上证据较弱，且简单无类型动态检索已难以被显著超过，而 Reflexion 式记忆在 BIRD 上数值更高但成本更大。这有助于研究者判断何时该采用更结构化的因果记忆，何时更宽泛的记忆表示更可取，而不把该方法当作普遍最优方案。
cards.description: 该研究提出免训练的 MERIT 智能体，为 Text-to-SQL 修复维护在线双极性记忆，同时记录经 oracle 验证的正确修正与观察到的失败方向，并在后续轮次中仅在先前已完成轮次结束后进行检索。新意在于把“成功修复经验”作为可复用的跨查询知识，而不是每次重新发现；有用之处在于不更新模型参数即可改善执行准确率，并量化了其相对无状态迭代修复、无类型动态检索与 Reflexion 式记忆的差异。
keyPoints: MERIT 是免训练的 Text-to-SQL 修复智能体，不更新冻结模型参数，仅通过在线记忆影响后续生成。
记忆具有双极性：同时保存 oracle 验证的修正与观察到的失败方向，且仅检索较早已完成轮次的经验。
确定性分类器先给出粗粒度失败类型，再条件化混合词法—稠密检索器，为每次修正提供检索上下文。
在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 且初始预测与修复预算相同的条件下，Spider 执行准确率由 66.34% 升至 69.79%，BIRD 由 47.35% 升至 48.44%。

cards.titleEn: Expected Shortfall Factor Models Capture Common Tail Losses and Return Pricing
cards.originalTitle: Expected Shortfall Factor Models: Common Tail Losses and Expected Returns
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose ESFM, which combines observed risk exposures with latent common factors to model common variation in the severity of lower-tail losses in large panels of asset returns. Estimation uses an orthogonalized two-step procedure under which first-stage quantile estimation error has no first-order effect on the ES coefficient estimates; theoretical results include nonasymptotic error bounds, a finite-sample Gaussian approximation, and consistent selection of the number of latent factors. In an equity panel application, the common factors uncovered by ESFM react sharply to market stress and contain information not captured by mean and quantile factors. Average returns increase across portfolios sorted on ESFM exposure, with high-minus-low portfolios earning annualized returns of 8.0%--11.7% and Fama--French five-factor alphas of 10.3%--15.0%; these spreads remain positive and statistically significant after conditioning separately and jointly on mean- and quantile-factor exposures. Tail-by-tail spanning tests show that ESFM factors retain significant alphas after controlling for standard traded factors and the corresponding mean and quantile factors; adding ESFM to these benchmark factor sets increases the maximum attainable Sharpe ratio. The authors conclude that common loss severity is a distinct and priced dimension of downside risk. The return and alpha figures are empirical results based on the authors' specific sample and methodology and do not represent future performance or investment advice.
keyPointsEn: Proposes the expected shortfall factor model (ESFM) to characterize common variation in the severity of lower-tail losses in asset return panels, distinguishing it from mean factor models and quantile factor models.

The model combines observed risk exposures with latent common factors and uses an orthogonalized two-step estimation procedure so that first-stage quantile estimation error has no first-order effect on the ES coefficients.
Theoretical results include nonasymptotic error bounds for ES coefficients, a finite-sample Gaussian approximation, and consistent selection of the number of latent factors.
In the equity panel application, ESFM factors react sharply to market stress and contain information not captured by mean and quantile factors.
Average returns increase across portfolios sorted on ESFM exposure; high-minus-low portfolios earn annualized returns of 8.0%--11.7% and Fama--French five-factor alphas of 10.3%--15.0%.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This research advances the characterization of downside risk from tail thresholds or average returns to common loss severity, offering a new factor modeling framework for understanding common tail risk in asset returns. If its theoretical properties and empirical results are robust, ESFM may complement existing mean and quantile factor models for measuring and explaining downside risk exposures in risk management and asset pricing research.
cards.summary: 作者提出 ESFM，将观测到的风险暴露与潜在共同因子结合，以建模大规模资产收益面板中共同的下尾损失严重程度。估计采用正交化两步程序，使第一阶段分位数估计误差对 ES 系数估计无一阶影响；理论结果包括非渐近误差界、有限样本高斯近似和潜在因子数的一致选择。在股票面板应用中，ESFM 发现的共同因子对市场压力反应剧烈，且含有均值和分位数因子未包含的信息。基于 ESFM 暴露排序的组合平均收益递增，高低组合年化收益为 8.0%–11.7%，Fama–French 五因子 alpha 为 10.3%–15.0%；在单独和联合控制均值与分位数因子暴露后，这些价差仍为正且统计显著。尾部逐项 spanning 检验显示，在控制标准可交易因子及相应均值与分位数因子后，ESFM 因子仍保留显著 alpha；将 ESFM 加入基准因子集可提高最大可达到的 Sharpe 比率。作者据此认为，共同损失严重程度是下行风险中一个独立且被定价的维度。上述收益与 alpha 数字为作者基于特定样本和方法的实证结果，不代表未来表现或投资建议。
cards.title: 期望损失因子模型捕捉共同尾部损失与收益定价
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究将下行风险从尾部阈值或平均收益的刻画推进到共同损失严重程度，为理解资产收益中的共同尾部风险提供了新的因子建模框架。若其理论性质与实证结果稳健，ESFM 可能补充现有均值与分位数因子模型，用于风险管理和资产定价研究中对下行风险暴露的度量与解释。
cards.description: 该研究提出期望损失因子模型（ESFM），用于刻画大规模资产收益面板中共同的下尾损失严重程度。与均值因子模型和分位数因子模型分别捕捉平均收益与尾部阈值不同，ESFM 聚焦于阈值以下损失的平均严重程度的共同变动，并给出正交化两步估计、非渐近误差界与因子数一致选择。其实证结果显示，ESFM 因子对市场压力反应敏锐，且包含均值和分位数因子未捕捉的信息，为下行风险提供了一个可定价的新维度。
keyPoints: 提出期望损失因子模型（ESFM），刻画资产收益面板中共同的下尾损失严重程度，区别于均值因子模型和分位数因子模型。

理论结果包括 ES 系数的非渐近误差界、有限样本高斯近似以及潜在因子数的一致选择。
股票面板应用中，ESFM 因子对市场压力反应剧烈，并包含均值和分位数因子未捕捉的信息。

cards.titleEn: A Mobility-Aware Multi-Objective Matching Framework for EV-to-EV Energy Trading
cards.originalTitle: EVTradeMatch: A Mobility-Aware Multi-Objective Matching Framework for EV--EV Energy Trading
cards.summaryEn: Paper facts: the authors formulate a prediction-guided multi-objective mixed-integer linear program for matching EV providers and consumers, maximizing matching coverage, transferred energy, and charging-node suitability while minimizing mobility cost under spatial, temporal, one-to-one matching, and node capacity constraints; a tailored NSGA-II is developed to approximate Pareto-efficient solutions. Experiments report 74.2–82.8% higher transferred energy, 8.3–84.4% higher charging-node suitability, and 3.74–25.07 percentage-point higher matching coverage than proximity- and auction-based methods; balanced NSGA-II solutions achieve 53.07±0.76% matching coverage and transfer 1701.94±17.03 kWh, with higher mobility cost than travel-minimizing methods. Authors' view: these results indicate the framework enables flexible selection among high-coverage, high-energy, low-mobility-cost, and high-suitability solutions according to operational priorities.
keyPointsEn: Uses prediction-derived charging-node suitability as both a guidance signal and an explicit optimization objective rather than a hard selection rule.
Formulates EV–EV matching as a multi-objective mixed-integer linear program covering matching coverage, transferred energy, node suitability, and mobility cost.
Includes spatial, temporal, one-to-one matching, and charging-node capacity constraints.
Applies a tailored non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm II (NSGA-II) to approximate Pareto-efficient solutions in wide-area dynamic settings.
Reports 74.2–82.8% higher transferred energy and 8.3–84.4% higher charging-node suitability.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Under limited charging infrastructure, EV–EV energy trading can improve charging flexibility; by integrating mobility, energy, and contextual features into matching optimization and offering adjustable Pareto solutions, the framework helps operators choose strategies according to priorities such as coverage, energy, mobility cost, or node suitability.
cards.summary: 论文事实：作者构建了一个预测引导的多目标混合整数线性规划，用于电动汽车提供者与消费者之间的匹配，目标为最大化匹配覆盖率、转移能量与充电节点适宜性，同时最小化移动成本，并受时空、一对一匹配与节点容量约束；为近似帕累托有效解，作者设计了定制 NSGA-II 算法。实验报告称相较基于距离和拍卖的对比方法，转移能量提升 74.2–82.8%，节点适宜性提升 8.3–84.4%，匹配覆盖率提升 3.74–25.07 个百分点；均衡 NSGA-II 解达到 53.07±0.76% 匹配覆盖与 1701.94±17.03 kWh 转移能量，但移动成本高于以最小化行驶为目标的方法。作者观点：这些结果表明框架可按运营优先级在高覆盖、高能量、低移动成本与高适宜性解之间灵活选择。
cards.title: 面向电动汽车间能量交易的多目标匹配框架
cards.whyItMatters: 在充电基础设施有限的条件下，EV–EV 能量交易可提升充电灵活性；该框架把出行、能量与情境特征纳入匹配优化，并提供可调节的帕累托解，有助于运营方按覆盖、能量、移动成本或节点适宜性等优先级选择策略。
cards.description: 该论文提出 EVTradeMatch 框架，将充电节点适宜性从排序模型的预测分数转化为显式优化目标，在匹配覆盖、转移能量、适宜性与移动成本间求解帕累托解，为有限充电设施下的车对车能量交易提供可调度的匹配方案。
keyPoints: 将预测得到的充电节点适宜性分数同时用作引导信号和显式优化目标，而非硬性选择规则。
把 EV–EV 匹配建模为多目标混合整数线性规划，覆盖匹配覆盖、转移能量、节点适宜性与移动成本。
约束包含空间、时间、一对一匹配与充电节点容量。
采用定制非支配排序遗传算法 II（NSGA-II）近似宽域动态场景下的帕累托有效解。
实验结果报告转移能量提升 74.2–82.8%，节点适宜性提升 8.3–84.4%。
cards.descriptionEn: This paper proposes EVTradeMatch, a framework that converts charging-node suitability predicted by a ranking model into an explicit optimization objective, seeking Pareto solutions among matching coverage, transferred energy, suitability, and mobility cost to support schedulable vehicle-to-vehicle energy matching under limited charging infrastructure.

cards.limitations: 论文侧重方法论与消融实验，摘要未给出具体误差数值、统计显著性检验、置信区间或跨市场外部验证；实验对象限于异构加密资产，未说明是否覆盖传统金融资产或其他频率数据；OHLC 软可行性损失仅惩罚不等式违反，不保证预测在经济学意义上可交易或可执行；未讨论交易成本、滑点、流动性、市场冲击与制度变化；RevIN 内损失归一化的梯度几何分析基于特定假设，其通用性需进一步验证；通道依赖归一化对蜡烛顺序关系的保持是设计论证，未在摘要中给出对所有模型架构的普适性证明。
cards.limitationsEn: The paper emphasizes methodology and ablations; the abstract provides no specific error values, statistical significance tests, confidence intervals, or cross-market external validation. Experiments are limited to heterogeneous cryptocurrency assets, with no indication of coverage of traditional financial assets or other data frequencies. The soft OHLC feasibility loss only penalizes inequality violations and does not guarantee economically tradable or executable predictions. Transaction costs, slippage, liquidity, market impact, and regime changes are not discussed. The gradient-geometry analysis under RevIN-internal loss normalization relies on specific assumptions, and its generality requires further verification. Preservation of candle-order relations under channel-dependent normalization is a design argument, not a universal proof for all model architectures in the abstract.
cards.titleEn: CryptoL: A Unified Framework for Scale and Physics Constraints in Cryptocurrency Multivariate Forecasting
cards.originalTitle: CryptoL: Towards Scale Dominance and Physics Constraints Mitigation in Financial Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
cards.summaryEn: Paper facts: CryptoL targets multivariate OHLC forecasting for cryptocurrencies with four design elements: evaluating error in context-normalized coordinates within RevIN and characterizing through empirical risk and parameter-gradient geometry how large-scale assets can disproportionately influence shared-model optimization; comparing channel-independent and channel-dependent normalization and arguing that a shared channel-dependent affine transformation preserves candle-order relations; introducing scale-adaptive numerical stabilization to reduce distortions from a fixed normalization constant across assets spanning many orders of magnitude; and adding a soft feasibility loss penalizing violations of defining OHLC inequalities. Experiments on heterogeneous cryptocurrency assets use controlled ablations and report improvements in forecasting accuracy, training stability, and the frequency of financially valid OHLC predictions relative to baselines. Author view: these components form an integrated approach to scale-balanced optimization, structure-preserving normalization, numerical stabilization, and constraint-aware forecasting. The abstract does not report specific numerical values, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests.
keyPointsEn: Evaluates loss in context-normalized coordinates within the RevIN pipeline, preventing inverse normalization from adding squared-scale weighting to the MSE objective
Characterizes via empirical risk and parameter-gradient geometry the conditions under which large-scale assets can disproportionately influence shared-model optimization
Compares channel-independent and channel-dependent normalization, arguing a shared channel-dependent affine transformation preserves OHLC candle-order relations
Introduces scale-adaptive numerical stabilization to reduce distortions caused by a fixed normalization constant across assets spanning many orders of magnitude
Adds a soft feasibility loss penalizing violations of defining OHLC inequalities to increase financially valid predictions
cards.whyItMattersEn: In cryptocurrency forecasting, cross-asset scale differences can span orders of magnitude; conventional MSE and fixed normalization can amplify these differences, distort shared-model optimization, and yield predictions that violate basic OHLC inequalities. CryptoL maps these failure sources to loss space, normalization structure, numerical stability, and output constraints, offering an ablatable design for scale balancing and structural feasibility in multivariate financial time-series forecasting. It may help subsequent research assess financial validity and stability of predictions without implying investment advice.
cards.summary: 论文事实：CryptoL 面向加密货币 OHLC 多变量预测，提出四项设计：在 RevIN 内用情境归一化坐标评估预测误差，并从经验风险与参数梯度几何刻画大尺度资产对共享模型优化的不成比例影响；比较通道独立与通道依赖归一化，指出共享的通道依赖仿射变换可保持蜡烛顺序关系；引入尺度自适应数值稳定以缓解固定归一化常数在跨多个数量级资产上的失真；加入软可行性损失惩罚违反 OHLC 不等式。实验在异构加密资产上通过受控消融评估，报告相对基线在预测精度、训练稳定性和财务有效 OHLC 预测频率上的改进。作者观点：这些组件共同构成尺度平衡优化、结构保持归一化、数值稳定与约束感知预测的集成方案。该摘要未报告具体数值、置信区间或统计显著性检验结果。
cards.title: CryptoL 统一框架：解决加密货币多变量预测中的尺度与物理约束问题
cards.whyItMatters: 加密货币预测中跨资产尺度差异可达多个数量级，常规 MSE 与固定归一化会放大尺度差异、扭曲共享模型优化，并可能产出违反 OHLC 基本不等式的无效预测。CryptoL 将这些失效来源分别对应到损失空间、归一化结构、数值稳定与输出约束四个层面，为多变量金融时序预测中的尺度平衡与结构可行性提供可消融检验的设计思路，有助于后续研究在不引入投资建议的前提下评估模型预测的财务有效性与稳定性。
cards.description: 针对加密货币 OHLC 预测中跨资产尺度差异大、非平稳性强、结构约束易被破坏的问题，CryptoL 提出在 RevIN 流程内以情境归一化坐标计算损失，避免反归一化给 MSE 带来额外平方尺度加权；同时检验通道依赖归一化对蜡烛顺序关系的保持，引入尺度自适应数值稳定与 OHLC 不等式软惩罚，并通过消融实验验证精度、训练稳定性与有效预测频率的改进。
keyPoints: 在 RevIN 流程内以情境归一化坐标计算损失，防止反归一化给 MSE 目标引入额外平方尺度加权
从经验风险与参数梯度几何刻画大尺度资产在共享模型优化中可能产生不成比例影响的条件
比较通道独立与通道依赖归一化，认为共享通道依赖仿射变换可保持 OHLC 蜡烛顺序关系
引入尺度自适应数值稳定，减少固定归一化常数在跨多个数量级资产上造成的失真
加入软可行性损失惩罚违反 OHLC 定义不等式，提升财务有效预测频率
cards.descriptionEn: To address extreme cross-asset scale heterogeneity, non-stationarity, and structural constraints in cryptocurrency OHLC forecasting, CryptoL evaluates forecasting error in context-normalized coordinates within the RevIN pipeline to prevent inverse normalization from adding squared-scale weighting to the MSE objective. It examines channel-dependent normalization for preserving candle-order relations, incorporates scale-adaptive numerical stabilization, and adds a soft feasibil

cards.limitations: 论文摘要仅给出方向性结论，未披露具体基准、消融规模、动作数量差异幅度与统计显著性。LASI 作为作者实验观察，其普遍性与根因边界未在输入中说明。数据构建依赖同步的游戏与图形界面轨迹，泛化到未见游戏、真实用户界面或不同控制设备尚未验证。任务成功率与动作数对比仅相对特定对照智能体，不能推断为普遍优势，也不构成任何投资或应用建议。
cards.limitationsEn: The abstract provides only directional conclusions, without concrete benchmarks, ablation scale, magnitude of action-count differences, or statistical significance. LASI is an experimental observation by the authors, and its generality and root causes are not specified in the input. Data construction depends on synchronized gameplay and GUI trajectories; generalization to unseen games, real user interfaces, or different control devices is not verified. Task success and action-count comparisons are relative to specific compared agents and cannot be inferred as universal advantages, nor do they constitute investment or application advice.
cards.titleEn: GameWAM: A World Action Model for Native Closed-Loop Gameplay and GUI Control
cards.originalTitle: GameWAM: A World Action Model for Video Games
cards.summaryEn: Fact: the paper introduces GameWAM, described as a world action model for native closed-loop gameplay and GUI control. Methodologically, it jointly generates future visual observations and executable keyboard-mouse trajectories through parallel visual and action generative processes with block-causal conditioning and flow matching. It constructs synchronized gameplay and GUI trajectories to support joint world-action learning, predicts a gameplay/GUI mode per action step with mode-specific prediction distributions and continuous-action normalization, and uses block-cycle control that coordinates prediction, execution, and temporal context via short action blocks, replanning from new observations, and hierarchical context from fine-grained within-cycle history to persistent cross-cycle history. Experiments report competitive task success with fewer executed native actions than compared agents. The authors also report Low-Frequency Action Source Imprinting. Author view: WAMs unify world model and policy objectives but remain largely unexplored under game dynamics and open-ended interaction, and GameWAM addresses this gap; block-cycle control helps long-horizon interaction.
keyPointsEn: GameWAM is positioned as a world action model for native closed-loop gameplay and GUI control, jointly generating future visual observations and keyboard-mouse action trajectories.
The method uses parallel visual and action generation with block-causal conditioning and flow matching to learn joint world-action representations.
To handle heterogeneous native control, it predicts a gameplay/GUI mode per action step and uses mode-specific prediction distributions and continuous-action normalization.
Block-cycle control coordinates prediction, execution, and replanning: predicting beyond the committed horizon, executing short action blocks, and replanning from new observations.
Context is hierarchically structured from fine-grained within-cycle history to persistent cross-cycle history to support long-horizon interaction.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If a world action model can jointly model future visuals and executable control in native gameplay and GUI settings, agents may shift from reactive behavior toward prediction-based closed-loop planning while reducing executed actions. This offers a unified research path for policy learning and generative control in interactive environments, and the reported action-source sensitivity failure mode suggests evaluations should examine sampling-source stability.
cards.summary: 事实：论文提出 GameWAM，称其为面向原生闭环游戏与图形界面控制的世界动作模型。方法上，它通过并行视觉与动作生成过程、块因果条件与流匹配，联合生成未来视觉观测和可执行的键鼠轨迹；构建同步的游戏与图形界面轨迹数据以支持联合学习；在每步预测游戏或界面模式，并采用模式特定预测分布与连续动作归一化处理异构原生控制；块循环控制协调预测、执行与时间上下文，支持短动作块执行与基于新观测的重规划，并将上下文分层为周期内细粒度历史与跨周期持久历史。实验结果显示其任务成功率具有竞争力，且执行的原生动作数量少于对照智能体。作者还报告了低频动作源印记现象。作者观点：世界动作模型统一了世界模型与策略目标，但在游戏动态与开放式交互下仍缺乏探索，GameWAM 填补这一空白；块循环控制有助于长时程交互。
cards.title: GameWAM：面向原生游戏闭环的世界动作模型
cards.whyItMatters: 若世界动作模型能在原生游戏与图形界面中同时建模未来视觉与可执行控制，智能体可能从被动反应转向基于预测的闭环规划，并减少实际执行动作。这为交互式环境中的策略学习与生成式控制提供了统一研究路径，同时其报告的动作源敏感失败模式提示生成式控制评估需关注采样源稳定性。
cards.description: 该工作提出 GameWAM，将世界模型与动作策略统一进同一生成框架，用于原生游戏闭环与图形界面控制。它并行生成未来视觉观测与可执行的键鼠轨迹，并显式处理游戏/界面两种控制模式与长时程交互，从而在任务成功率和执行动作数量上取得竞争性表现，并暴露了生成式控制中的动作源敏感失败模式。
keyPoints: GameWAM 被定位为面向原生闭环游戏与图形界面控制的世界动作模型，联合生成未来视觉观测与键鼠动作轨迹。
方法采用并行视觉与动作生成、块因果条件与流匹配，以学习联合世界与动作表示。
为处理异构原生控制，模型逐步预测游戏或界面模式，并使用模式特定预测分布与连续动作归一化。
块循环控制协调预测、执行与重规划：预测超出已提交范围，执行短动作块，并从新观测重规划。
上下文按周期内细粒度历史与跨周期持久历史分层组织，以支持长时程交互。
cards.descriptionEn: GameWAM unifies world modeling and action policy in one generative framework for native closed-loop gameplay and GUI control. It jointly generates future visual observations and executable keyboard-mouse trajectories, explicitly handles gameplay/GUI control modes and long-horizon interaction, achieves competitive task success with fewer executed native actions, and exposes a source-sensitivity failure mode in generative control.

cards.limitations: 证据边界：所有结论均来自论文摘要，未提供具体风险-收益数值、样本外测试细节、交易成本、滑点或统计显著性。实验在零智能限价订单簿中校准和测试，该环境与现实市场（含策略性订单、延迟、费用、市场冲击）存在差距。RLMM 在持续方向性失衡下仍出现库存饱和与大幅回撤，说明平稳训练策略的稳健性有限。情景赌博机步骤的改进仅在论文所述压力情景中报告，未说明其泛化能力。辅助信号依赖贝叶斯在线变点滤波与队列调整，在真实数据中的参数敏感性和延迟未讨论。本文不构成投资建议。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: all conclusions come from the paper abstract; no specific risk-return values, out-of-sample testing details, transaction costs, slippage, or statistical significance are provided. Experiments are calibrated and tested in a zero-intelligence limit order book, which differs from real markets (strategic orders, latency, fees, market impact). RLMM still exhibits inventory saturation and large drawdowns under persistent directional imbalance, indicating limited robustness of stationarily trained strategies. Improvements from the scenario-bandit step are reported only under the paper's stress scenarios, with no evidence on generalization. Parameter sensitivity and latency of the auxiliary Bayesian online change-point filter and queue adjustment in real data are not discussed. This does not constitute investment advice.
cards.titleEn: Deep Reinforcement Learning Market Making Robust to Regime-Switching Order Flow
cards.originalTitle: Deep Learning of Robust Market Making under Regime-Switching Order Flow
cards.summaryEn: Paper facts: Classical stochastic-control market-making strategies (e.g., Avellaneda-Stoikov and the GLFT extension) provide closed-form quoting rules but rely on assumptions such as stationary order flow; empirical evidence points to regimes possibly associated with algorithmic execution of metaorders, under which these methods yield negative PnL. The authors develop RLMM, a Rainbow-style distributional DQN (C51) market maker, calibrated and tested in a zero-intelligence limit order book. In the stationary setting, RLMM outperforms GLFT across the entire observed risk-return frontier; RLMM is more robust to flow asymmetry than GLFT, but, like any stationarily trained strategy, it still suffers large drawdowns from inventory saturation under persistent directional imbalance. Augmenting the RLMM state with two auxiliary signals—a Bayesian online change-point filter over the directional flow bias and a queue-adjusted quote-exposure imbalance—restores profitability; a final scenario-bandit step that reweights low-return regime scenarios further improves performance under random-persistence and correlated-direction stress. Author views (to be distinguished from facts): the RLMM framework can address market-making difficulties caused by regime-switching order flow, and the auxiliary signals and scenario-bandit step are effective improvement components. All above are from the abstract; no specific numerical values, experimental details, or statistical significance are provided.
keyPointsEn: Classical market-making models (Avellaneda-Stoikov, GLFT) produce negative PnL when order flow is non-stationary because their assumptions break down at realistic microstructure timescales.
The authors propose RLMM, a Rainbow-style distributional DQN (C51) market maker, calibrated and tested in a zero-intelligence limit order book.
In the stationary setting, RLMM outperforms GLFT across the entire observed risk-return frontier.
RLMM is more robust to flow asymmetry than GLFT, but still suffers large drawdowns from inventory saturation under persistent directional imbalance.
Augmenting the state with a Bayesian online change-point filter over directional flow bias and a queue-adjusted quote-exposure imbalance restores profitability.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Market-making strategies face regime-switching order flow in real markets, where classical closed-form solutions may fail and cause losses. This study shows deep RL can outperform GLFT in the stationary setting and highlights the limitations of stationary training alone; introducing online change-point detection, quote-exposure imbalance signals, and scenario reweighting can improve robustness under non-stationary stress. It provides experimental evidence for shifting quantitative market making from static assumptions toward adaptive, regime-aware methods, but conclusions are based on calibration in a zero-intelligence order book and require careful evaluation before practical deployment.
cards.summary: 论文事实：经典随机控制做市策略（如 Avellaneda-Stoikov 与 GLFT 扩展）提供闭式报价规则，但依赖订单流平稳等假设；实证证据表明订单流存在状态（可能由元订单算法执行导致），此时这些方法产生负盈亏。作者开发了 Rainbow 风格分布式 DQN（C51）做市智能体 RLMM，并在零智能限价订单簿中校准和测试。在平稳设定下，RLMM 在整个观测到的风险-收益前沿上优于 GLFT；RLMM 对流量不对称比 GLFT 更稳健，但像任何平稳训练策略一样，在持续方向性失衡下仍会因库存饱和遭受大幅回撤。将 RLMM 状态加入两个辅助信号（方向流偏差的贝叶斯在线变点滤波器与队列调整的报价暴露失衡）后恢复盈利；最后的情景赌博机步骤对低收益状态情景重新加权，在随机持续性和相关方向压力下进一步提升表现。作者观点（需与事实区分）：RLMM 框架能应对订单流状态切换带来的做市困难；辅助信号与情景赌博机是有效的改进组件。以上均来自摘要，未涉及具体数值、实验细节或统计显著性。
cards.title: 深度强化学习做市策略在订单流状态切换下的稳健性改进
cards.whyItMatters: 做市策略在真实市场中面临订单流状态切换，经典闭式解可能失效并造成亏损。该研究显示深度强化学习在平稳设定下可超越 GLFT，并指出仅靠平稳训练的局限；通过引入在线变点检测与报价暴露失衡信号，以及情景重加权，可提升在非平稳压力情景下的稳健性。这为量化做市从静态假设转向自适应、状态感知的方法提供了实验依据，但结论基于零智能订单簿校准，实际部署需谨慎评估。
cards.description: 该研究针对经典做市策略（Avellaneda-Stoikov、GLFT）在订单流非平稳（存在状态切换）时出现负盈亏的问题，提出一种基于分布式深度Q网络（Rainbow风格 C51）的做市智能体 RLMM。其新意在于在零智能限价订单簿中校准与测试，并发现仅靠平稳训练仍会在持续方向性失衡下出现库存饱和导致的大幅回撤，而加入两个辅助信号——方向流偏差的贝叶斯在线变点滤波器与队列调整的报价暴露失衡——可恢复盈利，最后用情景赌博机步骤进一步改善压力情景表现。对量化做市研究而言，这提供了
keyPoints: 经典做市模型（Avellaneda-Stoikov、GLFT）在订单流非平稳时会产生负盈亏，因为其假设在现实微观结构时间尺度上失效。
作者提出 Rainbow 风格分布式 DQN（C51）做市智能体 RLMM，并在零智能限价订单簿中校准与测试。

cards.titleEn: A Dual-Hypergraph Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Misconception Diagnosis by Novice Math Teachers
cards.originalTitle: MisEdu-RAG: A Misconception-Aware Dual-Hypergraph RAG for Novice Math Teachers
cards.summaryEn: Facts: Novice math teachers often struggle to diagnose and remediate student errors. Existing large language model platforms can generate instructional feedback, but they loosely connect pedagogical knowledge with student mistakes, making guidance less actionable. The authors propose MisEdu-RAG, a dual-hypergraph-based retrieval-augmented generation framework that organizes pedagogical knowledge as a concept hypergraph and real student mistake cases as an instance hypergraph. Given a query, it performs two-stage retrieval and generates responses grounded in retrieved cases and pedagogical principles. On MisstepMath, it improves token-F1 by 10.95% and yields up to 15.3% higher five-dimension response quality versus baselines, with largest gains on Diversity and Empowerment. A pilot study with 221 teacher questionnaires and 6 novice interviews suggests it provides diagnosis results and concrete teaching moves for high-demand misconception scenarios. Authors' view: the framework shows strong potential for scalable teacher training and AI-assisted instruction for misconception handling.

Performs two-stage retrieval at query time to gather connected evidence from both the concept and instance layers
Generates responses grounded in retrieved mistake cases and pedagogical principles rather than loose associations
On the MisstepMath benchmark, improves token-F1 by 10.95% over baselines
Achieves up to 15.3% higher five-dimension response quality, with largest gains on Diversity and Empowerment
cards.whyItMattersEn: A common difficulty for novice math teachers is identifying the cause of a student's error and giving an actionable instructional strategy; feedback from directly prompting large language models is often hard to implement because knowledge and error cases remain disconnected. This framework attempts to explicitly link pedagogical principles with real error cases through dual-hypergraph retrieval, making feedback more actionable and offering a testable technical path for scalable teacher training and AI-assisted instruction.

cards.titleEn: Market-Informed Networks Improve Modeling and Forecast Evaluation of Financial Extremes
cards.originalTitle: Market-Informed Networks for Modeling and Forecast Evaluation of Financial Extremes
cards.summaryEn: Facts: The study proposes a time-dependent Hüsler-Reiss network model where adjacency matrices determined by market information control how strongly observations contribute to estimation, offering binary and weighted specifications; the Joint Extremes Adjacency Matrix (JEAM) combines information about individual extremeness with historical patterns of joint extreme movements. In forecast evaluation covering one-minute stock returns from three sectors of the S&P 100, JEAM achieves the best out-of-sample log scores in both tail directions, improving scores by 12.5%–13.6% in the lower tail and 11.4%–14.9% in the upper tail. Authors' view: the results show that incorporating market-informed network structures in estimation improves forecast evaluation of extremes across time series.
keyPointsEn: Proposes a time-dependent Hüsler-Reiss network model in which market-informed adjacency matrices determine how strongly observations contribute to estimation.
Offers binary and weighted specifications, with JEAM combining individual extremeness and historical patterns of joint extreme movements.
High-dimensional financial extremes are sparse, and locally extreme observations are not necessarily extreme relative to their full marginal distribution.
Forecast evaluation covers one-minute stock returns from three sectors of the S&P 100.
JEAM achieves the best out-of-sample log scores in both tail directions: 12.5%–13.6% improvement in the lower tail and 11.4%–14.9% in the upper tail.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study offers a way to incorporate market network structure into modeling the joint distribution of high-dimensional financial extremes and evaluating forecasts. If robust, it could help researchers improve probabilistic forecast evaluation for tail directions under sparse extreme observations; however, practical effects depend on the data, market, and evaluation setup and should not be extrapolated directly into trading or investment conclusions.

cards.titleEn: AI Economist Agent: Linking Evidence Retrieval and Quantitative Models with RAG and Knowledge Graphs
cards.originalTitle: AI Economist Agent: An Agentic Framework for Evidence-Based Economic and Financial Analysis with RAG, Knowledge Graphs, and Large Language Models
cards.summaryEn: Facts: The paper proposes an AI economist agent framework for economic and financial scenario analysis, combining LLM agents, retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, and registered quantitative models. LLM agents plan the analysis, retrieve relevant evidence, and organize economic mechanisms; quantitative models generate numerical outcomes; predefined tests decide whether intermediate results can be used in the final report. The authors apply it to European macro-financial stress scenarios and bank capital analysis, evaluating retrieval of economic mechanisms, scenario construction, model execution, and report generation under a historical information cutoff. Authors' view: fluent LLM narratives alone are insufficient to establish the model-based calculations needed for economic conclusions; linking evidence retrieval and scenario construction to identifiable sources and explicit model calculations is key to making the analysis more reliable.
keyPointsEn: The framework combines LLM agents, retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, and registered quantitative models, with agents planning and retrieving, models producing numbers, and tests providing checks.
LLM agents are used to plan the analysis, retrieve evidence, and organize economic mechanisms, rather than directly producing final numerical conclusions.
Numerical outcomes are generated by registered quantitative models, and predefined tests determine whether intermediate results can be used in the final report.
The application domains are European macro-financial stress scenarios and bank capital analysis.
Evaluation covers retrieval of economic mechanisms, scenario construction, model execution, and report generation, conducted under a historical information cutoff.
cards.whyItMattersEn: In quantitative research and financial risk analysis, scenario design often requires assessing emerging risks with limited historical precedent, combining many sources, and translating qualitative mechanisms into internally consistent quantitative paths. The framework's significance lies in its attempt to constrain LLM-generated analysis with registered, testable quantitative models, so conclusions can be traced to sources and calculations rather than remaining at the narrative level. This offers methodological value for macro-financial stress testing, bank capital analysis, and similar tasks that require audit trails and model explainability.

cards.whyItMatters: 在量化研究与金融风险分析中，情景设计常需在历史先例有限时评估新兴风险，并整合多源信息，把定性机制转成内部一致的量化路径。该框架的意义在于尝试用可注册、可测试的量化模型约束LLM生成的分析，使结论可追溯至来源与计算，而非停留在叙述层面。这对需要审计线索和模型可解释性的宏观金融压力测试、银行资本分析等任务具有方法参考价值。

cards.limitations: 证据边界：结论基于三个经典微观结构模型，包括单期Kyle、Glosten-Milgrom和连续时间Kyle-Back，并假设噪声为高斯、二元方向通道或布朗通道；补贴闭式解与四阶/二阶损失比较依赖于这些模型设定及明确配置交易价值的假设。论文未提供实证市场数据检验，也未涵盖其他订单流特征、现实摩擦或监管约束；内生化隐私选择的闭式解同样在模型框架内成立。应用时需注意模型假设与实际市场的差异，不宜直接外推为具体交易策略或投资建议。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: The conclusions rest on three canonical microstructure models—single-period Kyle, Glosten-Milgrom, and continuous-time Kyle-Back—with assumptions of Gaussian noise, a binary direction channel, or a Brownian channel; the closed-form subsidy and the fourth-order versus second-order loss comparison depend on these model settings and an explicit allocative value of trade. The paper provides no empirical market data tests and does not cover other order flow features, real-world frictions, or regulatory constraints; the closed-form interior privacy choice also holds within the model framework. Applications should note differences between model assumptions and actual markets, and the results should not be directly extrapolated into specific trading strategies or investment advice.
cards.titleEn: Privacy Subsidy: Welfare Transfers in Market Making Under Coarsened Signals
cards.originalTitle: The Privacy Subsidy in Market Microstructure
cards.summaryEn: Facts: The paper sets up a privacy-preserving exchange that prices on a coarsened view of order flow, proving that a market maker committed to posterior-mean pricing on a signal strictly coarser than the flow it settles necessarily generates a closed-form welfare transfer called the privacy subsidy; it provides closed-form solutions in single-period Kyle, Glosten-Milgrom, and continuous-time Kyle-Back models. Author's view: The subsidy has a structural correspondence with Loss-Versus-Rebalancing, both welfare rates factorising as a squared noise driver times a committed-object factor; the gross subsidy can be recovered by a break-even fee, but that fee distorts volume, and under an explicit allocative value of trade the resulting deadweight is fourth-order in the noise scale while the gross subsidy is second-order, so privacy is welfare-neutral to leading order with a strictly smaller irrecoverable loss; endogenising the privacy level, a protocol trading a differential-privacy benefit against this deadweight chooses an interior noise scale in closed form, preserving the half-revealing product of price impact and informed intensity while unpinning the volatility-elasticity of price impact from its textbook value of one.
keyPointsEn: A market maker pricing on a signal coarser than the settled flow via posterior mean necessarily generates a closed-form welfare transfer, the privacy subsidy.
No rule restricted to the coarse signal can be simultaneously efficient and zero-profit against the settled flow.
The subsidy has closed-form solutions in single-period Kyle, Glosten-Milgrom, and continuous-time Kyle-Back models.
The subsidy has a structural correspondence with Loss-Versus-Rebalancing, with welfare rates factorising as a squared noise driver times a committed-object factor.
The gross subsidy can be recovered by a break-even fee, but that fee distorts volume and creates deadweight loss.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work provides a microstructure-level welfare framework for privacy-preserving market design: it shows that privacy is not free but takes the form of a measurable subsidy transferred from the market maker to traders; and that while recovering it via fees introduces volume distortions, to leading order privacy can be welfare-neutral with a strictly smaller irrecoverable loss. It offers theoretical reference for understanding pricing, fee design, and noise parameter selection in privacy-oriented exchanges.

cards.titleEn: Modeling S&P 500 Financial Time Series with ϕ⁴ Quantum Field Theory
cards.originalTitle: Modeling financial time series with $\phi^{4}$ quantum field theory
cards.summaryEn: The paper uses a ϕ⁴ quantum field theory with inhomogeneous couplings and explicit symmetry-breaking to model an ensemble of financial time series from the S&P 500 index. The authors point out that the continuum nature of the ϕ⁴ theory avoids the inaccuracies that occur in Ising-based models which require discretization of the time series, and they demonstrate this using the 2008 global financial crisis as an example. The theory is expressive enough to reproduce higher-order statistics such as market kurtosis, whereas binarized models cannot accurately reproduce high kurtosis. The authors then investigate the scaling properties of the ϕ⁴ machine learning algorithm and extract exponents that govern the behavior of the learned couplings (weights and biases in ML language) in relation to the number of stocks. Finally, they use the model to forecast the price changes of AAPL, MSFT, and NVDA stocks, and discuss how the ϕ⁴ scalar field theory could be used to build investment strategies and the possible intuitions that QFT operations of dimensional compactification and renormalization can provide for financial modeling. The above statements are those of the original authors and do not involve independent verification or investment advice.
keyPointsEn: Models S&P 500 financial time series with a ϕ⁴ quantum field theory featuring inhomogeneous couplings and explicit symmetry-breaking.
The continuum nature of the ϕ⁴ theory avoids the inaccuracies caused by the discretization of time series required in Ising-based models.
Uses the 2008 global financial crisis as an example to demonstrate the model's capability.
The ϕ⁴ model can reproduce higher-order statistics such as market kurtosis, while binarized Ising models cannot accurately reproduce high kurtosis.
Investigates the scaling properties of the ϕ⁴ machine learning algorithm and extracts exponents governing the behavior of learned couplings with respect to the number of stocks.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If ϕ⁴ quantum field theory can more accurately capture higher-order statistical features of financial time series (such as kurtosis), it may improve the ability to indicate market shocks and provide a continuous field-theoretic framework different from traditional Ising models for financial modeling. The paper also explores its potential applications in forecasting individual stock price changes and building investment strategies, but the related conclusions require further verification.
cards.summary: 论文使用具有非均匀耦合和显式对称性破缺的ϕ⁴量子场论来建模S&P 500指数中一组金融时间序列。作者指出，ϕ⁴理论的连续性质避免了基于Ising的模型因时间序列离散化而产生的不准确，并以2008年全球金融危机为例进行说明。该理论能复现市场峰度等高阶统计量，而二值化模型无法准确复现高峰度。作者进一步研究了ϕ⁴机器学习算法的标度性质，提取了控制学习耦合（即机器学习中的权重和偏置）随股票数量变化的指数。最后，他们用该模型预测AAPL、MSFT和NVDA股票的价格变化，并讨论了ϕ⁴标量场论构建投资策略的可能方式，以及量子场论操作（维度紧致化和重整化）对金融建模可能提供的直觉。上述内容均为原作者陈述，未涉及独立验证或投资建议。
cards.title: 用ϕ⁴量子场论建模S&P 500金融时间序列
cards.whyItMatters: 若ϕ⁴量子场论能更准确地捕捉金融时间序列的高阶统计特征（如峰度），则可能改进对市场冲击的指示能力，并为金融建模提供不同于传统Ising模型的连续场论框架。文中还探讨了其在预测个股价格变化和构建投资策略方面的潜在应用，但相关结论需进一步验证。
